Make a clean, camera-readable 2-row × 3-column arrangement on the wood platform (lengthen platform if necessary). Far row LEFT CLOSED, far row MIDDLE CLOSED, far row RIGHT CLOSED. Preserve the source composition/accommodate the six cubes with subtle reframe and correct badges. Three remaining panels must stay intact.
